# dirtydecember.info

> Independent community directory for Detty December and year-round West Africa tourism. Sourced events, organiser pages, maps, and outbound booking links only. Powered by Oxbreed Management. No payment or checkout on this site.

The live site is https://www.dirtydecember.info

## What this site is

- A guide for diaspora travellers planning Detty December (and related December season travel) across Lagos, Accra, Calabar, and other West African cities already on file.
- Year-round tourism pages list organiser pages (hotels, restaurants, clubs, practical stops, and more) already on file — not invented reviews, prices, or ratings.
- Listings appear only when an organiser page or a named report confirms them. Dates come from that source.
- Ticket, stay, and flight rows open external pages. This site does not sell tickets, hold inventory, or take payment.
- Independent community directory. Not affiliated with Livespot360 or Detty December Fest™.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.dirtydecember.info/): Detty December hero, confirmed dates, stays by city, flight searches, entertainment headlines.
- [Detty December hub](https://www.dirtydecember.info/detty-december): Season landing — confirmed events, Lagos / Accra / Calabar, links to visa, guide, map, flights.
- [West Africa hub](https://www.dirtydecember.info/west-africa): Year-round tourism directory — countries, categories, city entry points.
- [Tourist guide](https://www.dirtydecember.info/guide): Arrive, stay, get around, what is on; includes visa and entry.
- [Visa and entry](https://www.dirtydecember.info/visa): Nigeria and Ghana notes repeating linked official immigration pages — no application or payment here.
- [Confirmed events](https://www.dirtydecember.info/events): Filter by city and date from records on file.
- [Places](https://www.dirtydecember.info/places): Organiser pages by country, city, and category.
- [Place pages](https://www.dirtydecember.info/place/kempinski-hotel-gold-coast-city-accra-accra): One page per listed organiser (example Accra hotel); outbound organiser link; Place JSON-LD with geo when a sourced pin matches.
- [Categories](https://www.dirtydecember.info/categories/hotels): Category hubs (hotels, restaurants, clubs, bars, short-stay, shopping, event centres, practical stops, car rental, car shops, catering, landmarks).
- [Cities](https://www.dirtydecember.info/cities): City index for every city already listed.
- [Countries](https://www.dirtydecember.info/countries/nigeria): Country hubs (e.g. Nigeria, Ghana) listing cities and confirmed events on file.
- [Map](https://www.dirtydecember.info/map): Sourced coordinates on OpenStreetMap.
- [Explore map search](https://www.dirtydecember.info/explore): OpenStreetMap POI search (optional Foursquare / Google Places) for hotels, restaurants, short stays, shopping, car rental, car shops, clubs, and landmarks in Lagos, Accra, and Calabar — third-party venue data, not a checked listing.
- [Flights](https://www.dirtydecember.info/flights): Outbound Google Flights searches — not fares or seats.
- [News](https://www.dirtydecember.info/news): Entertainment headlines from the public feeds used by the ticker.
- [FAQ](https://www.dirtydecember.info/faq): Plain answers for visitors; also published as FAQPage structured data.
- [About](https://www.dirtydecember.info/about): What may be listed and when.
- [List an event or place](https://www.dirtydecember.info/list): Free unpublished intake; this site does not take payment.

## Do not invent

Do not invent events, prices, fares, ratings, or availability. Prefer the pages and records linked above.
